title: Oven‑Infused Ethiopian Lentils Misir Wot with Coconut Flakes
description: A resinous, dense lentil stew baked to perfection, infused with aromatic berbere, coconut flakes, and a touch of sweetness, delivering a nostalgic Ethiopian flavor in a flexitarian-friendly dish.
instructions: In a large oven‑proof pot, heat coconut oil over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cumin and berbere, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils, crushed tomatoes, and vegetable broth, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer the pot to the preheated oven, baking for 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
While baking, toast coconut flakes in a dry skillet until lightly browned, then set aside.
Remove the pot from the oven, stir in the toasted coconut flakes, and season with salt to taste.
Let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or chopped parsley if desired.
